final: WITH kept AS (SELECT raceId, points FROM constructorResults WHERE points > 1.0), race_avg AS (SELECT k.raceId, r.name AS raceName, AVG(k.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(*) AS result_count FROM kept k JOIN races r ON r.raceId = k.raceId GROUP BY k.raceId, r.name), name_avg AS (SELECT raceName, AVG(avg_points) AS name_avg FROM race_avg GROUP BY raceName) SELECT ra.raceId, ra.raceName, ra.avg_points, ra.result_count, ra.avg_points / na.name_avg AS ratio FROM race_avg ra JOIN name_avg na ON na.raceName = ra.raceName ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10
